title: WikiPulse: Event trail
description: One story from its first edit to its briefing, across services (Loki).

list.name: correlation_id
list.label: Correlation id
list.description: Paste an id from a spike, an event (Postgres: correlation_id) or any log line.

panels.title: Lines per service
panels.description: How many log lines each service wrote about this story in the time range: replay or consumer (the edit), detector (the spike), grouper (the event), graph and agent (extraction and briefing, with their LLM calls).

targets.expr: sum by (service) (count_over_time({system="wikipulse"} | (correlation_id!="" and correlation_id="$correlation_id") or (merged_correlation_id!="" and merged_correlation_id="$correlation_id") [$__range]))

panels.title: The trail
panels.description: Every line carrying the correlation id, oldest first. The id is the event_id of the edit that started the spike; the spike, its event and its briefing keep it. Open a line for its fields (service, event_key, trace_id: the Langfuse trace of the LLM calls).

targets.expr: {system="wikipulse"} | (correlation_id!="" and correlation_id="$correlation_id") or (merged_correlation_id!="" and merged_correlation_id="$correlation_id") | json
